title: Readwithjev
summary: An interactive reading demo pairs sentence-level emotion highlighting with a character map for navigating novels. Carl’s post shows how classification can become part of the reading interface.

title: jevsearch
summary: Kyle’s React search component uses Jev to reorder site-search results. It explores a small, focused use of classification inside an existing search experience.

title: Word house-style formatter
summary: Jan’s demo separates understanding a document’s house style from applying it. An LLM describes the styles first; Jev then chooses among them during formatting.

title: JevQL
summary: A project bringing semantic conditions to ordinary PostgreSQL queries. Kyle presents Jev as the decision layer behind WHERE clauses without requiring a database extension.

title: Browser Use flight search
summary: Gregor demonstrates a small browser agent that selects actions from the current page state. The flight-search example combines Jev decisions with a small language-model fallback for typing.
reportedLatency: 7 seconds for the demonstrated flight search

title: Oko code search
summary: Oko helps coding agents locate relevant source snippets through a local command-line tool and MCP. Jev ranks selected snippets, while keyword search can work without a model key.

title: tierjev
summary: Choose a set of items and a criterion, then let Jev score the items into a tier list. The project also supports manual adjustments and shareable results.

title: Spliit Cloud expense categorization
summary: This shared-expense project offers Jev as an optional category-selection engine. Suggestions remain reviewable, showing how classification can assist a familiar expense-entry workflow.
